newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crop condition and progress highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crop condition and progress highlights - USDA.

text.p: The U.S. Department of Agriculture on Monday rated 2 percent of the corn crop in very poor condition, 7 percent poor, 26 percent fair, 48 percent good and 17 percent excellent.
The department pegged 2 percent of the soybean crop in very poor condition, 8 percent poor, 31 percent fair, 48 percent good and 11 percent excellent.
The department said 14 pct of the corn crop was harvested, versus 9 percent last week, and 24 percent five-year average.
It said 17 percent of the soybean crop was harvested, compared to 4 percent last week, and the 31 percent five-year average.
USDA said 75 percent of the soybean crop was dropping leaves compared to 56 percent last week, and the 83 percent average.
USDA said 25 percent of the cotton crop was harvested versus 18 percent last week, and 25 percent average.
It said 28 percent of the winter wheat crop had emerged, compared to 18 percent a year ago and 34 percent average.
